Qwen2.5 report retrospectively states predecessor 1.2T tokens; retain discrepancy with S2 instead of resolving without evidence.
OpenCLIP ViT-bigG, patch stride 14, fixed-length 256 learned query cross-attention adapter with 2D absolute positions; box coordinates normalized to [0,1000).
Cross-attention standard QK softmax weighted V explanation; projections and positional treatment omitted, not an original numbered equation.
Three-stage training crop retains frozen/trained modules and data labels.
5B original pairs → 1.4B cleaned; consumed about 1.5B samples/500B image-text tokens; phase 1 224x224, frozen LLM, train vision+adapter.
Seven multitask types, 448x448, packing length 2048, full-model training; SFT 350K, freeze ViT, optimize language+adapter, answer/special-token supervision.
Qwen-VL TextVQA 63.8 / DocVQA 65.1; Qwen-VL-Chat 61.5 / 62.6. Chat is not uniformly higher.
Speech/video and scale are future directions; fixed-budget bottleneck is editorial analysis, not reported quantitative ablation.
Dynamic resolution with 2D-RoPE replaces absolute positions; 2x2 spatial merging; original architecture crop.
M-RoPE uses temporal/height/width components; text equal IDs, image constant temporal ID, video increasing temporal ID; new segment max ID+1.
Video 2 FPS, temporal-depth 2 3D convolution; images treated as two identical frames; training video budget 16384 tokens.
14px patch and 2x2 merge imply visual tokens=(Hprime/28)*(Wprime/28); 224x224 → 64 visual + 2 boundary = 66.
Three training stages; first ViT, second all, third frozen ViT/instruction-tuned LLM. Combined 1.4T counts text+vision but supervision text only.
Qwen2-VL-72B: MMMU val 64.5, MathVista testmini 70.5, DocVQA test 96.5; Claude3.5/GPT4o MMMU 68.3/69.1.
Qwen2-VL-7B fixed 3136 visual tokens: InfoVQA 77.27, OCRBench 786; dynamic average 1924: 75.89, 866. Not all-task dominance.
Qwen2-1.5B + ViT-L pretraining ablation: MathVista 39.2→43.4; NextQA 43.9→46.0; RealWorldQA 54.5→53.7; InfoVQA 50.8→50.3.
VLN map information incomplete/unstructured; 3D maps and locations remain a challenge.
Original architecture figure shows dynamic FPS, absolute-time alignment, window/full attention. Crop 419490 bytes prioritizes small-label readability.
ViT 32 layers; full attention indexes {7,15,23,31}; maximum 112x112 pixels/8x8 patches per window; RMSNorm and SwiGLU; from-scratch ViT.
Image sides multiples of 28; stride 14; 2x2 concat/two-layer MLP; actual image-size coordinates; dynamic FPS training and absolute-time-aligned MRoPE.
Global attention pairing O(N squared), fixed M-patch windows O(N*M); not full network linear complexity or measured latency.
Stages 1.5T/2T/0.6T, 8192/8192/32768; progressive data; dynamic LLM packing for GPU load balance.
SFT approximately 2M entries, 50/50 text versus multimodal sample count; SFT/DPO freeze ViT; DPO image-text and text only; filtering and rejection sampling.
72B MMMU val 70.2, MathVista mini 74.8, DocVQA test 96.4, TextVQA val 83.5. No isolated module gain inferred.
Original architecture crop; SigLIP2-SO-400M default / Large300M for 2B/4B; interpolation plus 2D-RoPE.
Interleaved axis frequency allocation; three ViT levels use specialized mergers added to first three LLM-layer hidden states.
Hidden-state addition schematic; exact ViT layer indexes and detailed residual execution order not asserted.
Video temporal patches prefixed with textual timestamps; seconds and HMS formats; predecessor absolute-time ID sparsity and data construction issues.
Four-stage pretraining (only merger then all), 67B/~1T/~1T/100B, context 8K/8K/32K/256K. Square-root normalized loss is mentioned but no invented precise equation.
Instruct/Thinking formats; SFT 32K→256K; text-only strong-to-weak off-policy and on-policy teacher/student KL distillation.
Reasoning RL approximately 30K queries, 16 responses, SAPO; General RL uses rule/model rewards, targeted behavior correction.
Visual-agent training on Qwen2.5-VL-32B then ~120K multiround interactions for Qwen3-VL; answer/feedback/tool-use rewards.
Flagship/midsize Instruct text evaluation: temperature0.7 top-p0.8 top-k20 presence1.5 max output32768. Not claimed as universal multimodal protocol.
235B total/22B active; Thinking/Instruct MMMU80.6/78.7 MathVista85.8/84.9 DocVQA96.5/97.1; preserve reasoning mode distinction.
Internal 15B-A2B,200B tokens,no posttraining validation: AVG74.7→76.0; InfoVQA71.9→74.2; DocVQA89.5→91.1; TextVQA80.6→80.5.
